# Startup readback: AI-68

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Add a compact, versioned execution contract to all currently open AI Operations Linear engineering issues without overwriting their unique test profiles. Introduce an issue-specific Codex parent-conversation readback before implementation and a CI validation check for AI-numbered PR branches.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

Reuse the current AGENTS.md rules, the existing qa:doctor and verify:changed commands, the core/boundary CI workflow, and the existing exact-candidate staging release gate. There is no existing Linear issue template available through the connected workspace; maintain a reusable repository source template instead.

## Implementation and boundaries

Add one small Node-only readback validator, its unit tests, an example filled readback and a versioned template. Add the validator to CI and a focused instruction to AGENTS.md. Keep real MFA manual and do not add a new staging or local QA harness.

## Local tests and commands

Check the validator with node --test infrastructure/scripts/ticket-readback.test.mjs; run node infrastructure/scripts/ticket-readback.mjs check AI-68; require the existing pnpm verify:changed checks in PR CI. Verify a missing readback, wrong issue, template content, and valid finished content all behave as expected.

## Hosted proof and readiness

No live-only provider or browser proof is justified for this governance change. Existing exact-candidate staging gates should continue relying on ordinary required PR checks; this changes the CI input, not authorization or release provenance.

## Delegation and blockers

No subagents are needed for this small governance change. The Linear connector has no template-creation action, so the repository carries the reusable source and open issues are updated via their existing descriptions. The desktop development machine is offline; use GitHub changes and CI checks for repository validation.
